verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's docs confirm scheduling 'links' as the core bookable unit, with API endpoints for scheduling links/events (savvycal-probe-rt-1) and general link customization (colors, banner, custom domain — savvycal-docs-33/34), implying multiple distinct links can be created. However, there is no explicit evidence of per-link duration settings, location options, custom question fields, or confirmation-rule configuration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of custom durations per link, location/conferencing selection per event type, custom intake questions, and confirmation/notification rule settings.
